crossRefs.note: These are the names of the sons of Gershon by their families: Libni and Shimei.

people.name: Gershon
people.line: Firstborn son of Levi; head of the Gershonite Levites.

people.name: Libni
people.line: Son of Gershon; grandson of Levi

people.name: Shimei
people.line: Son of Gershon and grandson of Levi.

translations.web: Of Gershon was the family of the Libnites, and the family of the Shimeites. These are the families of the Gershonites.
translations.bsb: From Gershon came the Libnite clan and the Shimeite clan; these were the Gershonite clans.
translations.kjv: Of Gershon was the family of the Libnites, and the family of the Shimites: these are the families of the Gershonites.
translations.asv: Of Gershon was the family of the Libnites, and the family of the Shimeites: these are the families of the Gershonites.
